description: SEC registration statements: S-1 (IPO, first-time registrants), S-3 (shelf), S-3ASR (automatic shelf of Well-Known Seasoned Issuers) and /A amendments. One row per filing, metadata only (details at primary_document_url). No S-8, S-4, F-series or 424B. An amendment chain shares sec_file_number. filer_name, s1_only, s3_only and exclude_amendments apply within the newest 3,000 filings the other filters select (coverage_warning says so). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_registration_statements
